title: Muser Metrics Contract v1
description: Wire contract between the muser inference engine and the web dashboard. MetricsSnapshot is returned by GET /snapshot and carried by authenticated GET /stream WebSocket schema-v2 frames; GET /metrics is Prometheus text and GET /telemetry is compatibility SSE. Numbers are tagged measured, target, or mock. See docs/launch-claims.md before any result reaches launch copy.

schema_version.description: Contract major version. Bumped on any breaking change to field shapes. Dashboard MUST refuse mismatched majors.

MetricsSnapshot.description: Complete engine state. Returned by GET /snapshot and carried as data in the authenticated /stream WebSocket snapshot keyframe; GET /metrics is Prometheus text and GET /telemetry remains a compatibility SSE keyframe route. Every section is a pure function of engine state so it can be re-serialized cheaply from live counters.

generated_at.description: Wall-clock ISO-8601 UTC when this snapshot was serialized.

engine_clock_s.description: Monotonic engine clock (seconds, float). Deltas reference this, not wall time.

_events.description: UI-convenience extension (note the leading underscore): the live lifecycle event log, newest-first, for the dashboard's event panel. Additive and ignorable by clients that only consume stable sections. The server has no simulator fallback.

_honesty.description: UI-convenience extension: per-section and per-field provenance tags using measured/target/mock. Emitted by the live server in /snapshot, /stream snapshots, and /telemetry compatibility keyframes. See docs/telemetry.md for authoritative field accounting.

_telemetry_viewers.description: UI-convenience extension: measured live count of currently-open /telemetry SSE and /stream WebSocket viewers.

_telemetry_requests.description: UI-convenience extension: [measured] lifetime count of GET /snapshot + GET /telemetry polls this process has served, kept out of wire.requests_per_s so that gauge describes product traffic only.

_active_connections.description: UI-convenience extension: [measured] live count of open sockets (dashboard viewers included), distinct from wire.connected_clients which counts active inference sessions.

_queue_depth.description: UI-convenience extension: [measured] requests accepted but not yet past first-token emission.

_overload_rejections.description: UI-convenience extension: [measured] counter of requests rejected by load shedding.

_lock_recoveries.description: UI-convenience extension: [measured] counter of poisoned-lease recoveries; non-zero means a generation panicked and the process kept serving.

_decode.description: UI-convenience extension: [measured] live decode throughput, kept separate from the historical Node.tok_s precedent figure.

completion_traffic_tok_s_10s.description: Completion traffic in tokens/s over the ten-second rolling window; not request-local decode throughput.

_remote.description: UI-convenience extension: [measured] remote-prefill health. A degraded disaggregated route is otherwise indistinguishable from one nobody exercised: both leave transfers[] empty.

receive_failures.description: Counter: authenticated GX10 remote-prefill receive attempts that failed verification/commit and did not become a Transfer entry.

fallbacks.description: Counter: requests that fell back to local prefill after a remote-prefill attempt did not complete.

last_error.description: Most recent remote-prefill failure message, if any.

_phases.description: Measured completed-sample request phase totals/means plus true last-request decode throughput.

cluster.description: Static-ish cluster identity for the header banner.

Node.description: One physical inference node. The v0.1 roles are GX10/GB10 CUDA prefill/storage and M3 Ultra Muser Metal decode. The live node collector is not wired and nodes is currently empty.

tok_s.description: Current node throughput. No node collector is wired in v0.1; the live server emits an empty nodes array.

KvCache.description: Aggregate KV cache state plus the Muse structural split. The two-class split is the story: 13 NoPE layers grow unbounded (position-free), 39 SWA layers are ring-windowed at 2048.

tokens_cached.description: Sum of live KV positions across sessions.

capacity_bytes.description: Resident KV budget for occupancy meter.

nope_growing_bytes.description: KV bytes in the 13 NoPE full layers. Grows with context; relocation = memcpy.

swa_windowed_bytes.description: KV bytes in the 39 SWA layers, bounded by window 2048.

per_session.description: Per-session KV footprint for the stacked occupancy bar.

Economics.description: THE HERO PANEL. kvpack cache economics: value quantified as GB-served-from-cache vs GB-recomputed, and the derived wall-time / compute / energy saved. All raw fields are monotonic counters since engine start (the dashboard rate-derives); `derived` and `hit_rate` are convenience projections the engine computes so every client agrees.

cache_hits.description: Counter: resume requests satisfied by a kvpack restore.

cache_misses.description: Counter: requests that fell back to full prefill (no usable cached KV).

bytes_served_from_cache.description: Counter: KV bytes materialized via restore instead of recompute. The 'GB from cache' number.

bytes_recomputed.description: Counter: KV bytes produced by prefill (misses + partials). The 'GB recomputed' number.

session_continuation_hits.description: [measured] Counter: prompt continuations of the same live session (CacheSource::CurrentSession) -- no restore ran, the KV was never evicted. Real and useful, but not a served hit; kept out of cache_hits/bytes_served_from_cache/tiers by the attribution fix so it never inflates the headline hit rate. muser-kvpack::economics::EconomicsCounters::record_session_continuation. See docs/kvpack-economics.md.

disagg_prefills.description: [measured] Counter: disaggregated remote prefills -- compute ran on another node (e.g. GX10), KV installed over the wire. Real prefill work, not a cache restore, so it is counted here instead of cache_hits/tiers by the same attribution fix. muser-kvpack::economics::EconomicsCounters::record_disagg_prefill. See docs/kvpack-economics.md.

disagg_bytes_installed.description: [measured] Bytes installed by disaggregated remote prefills -- the caller-supplied authenticated transfer size (docs/kvpack-economics.md notes this now sources from the GX10 RemoteReceiveReceipt), never folded into bytes_served_from_cache.

restore_speedup.description: Live restore-vs-prefill ratio (rolling), measured once a real paired RestoreTiming updates the EMA; otherwise zero/mock.

derived.description: Engine-computed savings. Formulas documented in metrics-schema.md; emitted so all clients agree on the headline.

seconds_saved.description: Cumulative positive difference between paired local-prefill and restore wall times. Measured only after a paired timing; otherwise zero/mock.

gflops_avoided.description: Model/topology-derived linear weight-matmul floor, not a measured hardware counter. Updated only for timed restores and tagged mock by the current three-value honesty vocabulary.

joules_saved.description: Unavailable without a calibrated power source; current server emits zero/mock.

tiers.description: Storage tiers the restore was served from, with occupancy and hit attribution. Powers the tier-breakdown bar.

remote.description: Remote KV pool served over the authenticated GX10 Handoff V2 transport (mTLS-TCP). Renamed from rdma_pool: the shipping transport is mTLS-TCP, not RDMA/RoCE -- RDMA/RoCE is a roadmap fast-lane upgrade (docs/muser-architecture.md), never a description of what today's tier actually runs over.

resident_bytes.description: Bytes currently held in THIS tier (name kept flat for wire compactness; per-tier occupancy).

hits.description: Counter: restores served from this tier.

Transfer.description: One active disaggregated KV handoff (prefill node -> decode node). Phase reflects the Muse amortization schedule: stream the 13 NoPE tiles DURING prefill, ship the 39 SWA planes only at the end.

phase.description: Handoff phase vocabulary. The current snapshot retains completed receipts only and therefore emits done.

throughput_gbps.description: Measured effective installed-payload rate in gigabits/s from committed bytes and receiver transfer time. The v0.1 release floor is a three-handoff median of at least 3.0 Gbps; this field makes no generic link-class claim.

hidden_pct.description: Fraction of this transfer overlapped with (hidden behind) prefill compute. [target] gate G-B2 >= 0.95.

_control_ns.description: UI-convenience extension: the receipt's own control-channel round-trip time, nanoseconds. [measured]. Part of the phase split alongside _accept_ns -- the commit itself is already visible as throughput_gbps.

_accept_ns.description: UI-convenience extension: the receipt's own producer-wait/accept time, nanoseconds. [measured].

itl_ms.description: Inter-token latency (p50/p95 of per-token emission gaps during decode). [measured].

origin.description: How this session began - resumed/migrated flag the differentiator.

SessionEvent.description: One lifecycle event retained in the snapshot event list. WebSocket changed-field deltas carry the updated list rather than a separate event frame.

detail.description: Free-form context for the toast/log row.

Trick.description: One qualified optimization and its contribution. The current server emits an empty list until exact-identity qualification passes.

kind.description: How to read `value`: multiplier=x throughput, percent=+% gain, ratio=X-fold, flag=boolean capability (1=on, render as a checkmark), killed=abandoned lever (value is not a win; render as a killed/struck-through state, never as a positive contribution).

value.description: Contribution value. The live server emits no Trick objects until the corresponding exact-identity qualification passes.

baseline.description: The exact baseline or proof point to which value is relative.

measured.description: true = the stated fact (a win, OR a kill verdict) is [measured]/proven this program; false = [target]/[mock]/pending. For kind=killed, measured=true means the KILL is proven, not that the lever is a win.

SpecDec.description: Live retrieval prompt-lookup speculative-decode telemetry. High-frequency; drives the accept-rate sparkline and the accepted-run ticker.

accept_rate.description: Rolling fraction of drafted tokens accepted.

accepted_run.description: Length of the most recent accepted draft run (0 on a reject).

draft_len.description: Tokens proposed in the last verify step (K-parallel).

per_weight_read_speedup.description: Effective speedup per weight read. Omitted by the live server because no in-process measurement supplies it.

ane_route_failures.description: [measured] Counter: DFlash draft attempts that fell off the public-CoreML ANE route and were retried/served on the Metal route.

metal_route_failures.description: [measured] Counter: DFlash draft attempts that failed on the Metal route.

seq.description: Monotonic per-connection sequence. Gap => client should request/await a fresh snapshot.

t.description: Engine monotonic clock (s, float) at emit.

WebSocketDataMessage.description: GET /stream WebSocket snapshot or changed-top-level-field delta.

WebSocketMessage.description: One GET /stream WebSocket JSON text frame. Ping is a WebSocket control frame and is not represented here.
